changes: 12 named, source-linked milestones retain the existing selection identifiers.
One linear conversion drives calendar dates, full-year markers, recent-history zooms and lifetime readouts.
Hour, minute and second views display separate selectable event rows and explicitly identify selections outside the window.
The present is the exact year-end boundary. Solar System formation maps to September 1; neutral-hydrogen formation maps to about 14.47 minutes after the start.
Formation phases and quoted age uncertainties are identified separately from approximate point examples.
Native lifetime range, keyboard event navigation and SVG touch/keyboard selection retain other saved investigations.
Phone contrast diagrams use readable labels and separated timeline ticks.
limits: Uses a rounded, fixed 13.8-billion-year age and a 365-day calendar.
Clock precision describes scale arithmetic. Universe-age uncertainty is not propagated.
Published ages are embedded examples; source links provide provenance. No live data fetch is required.
